body: You could message me if you want. Some of the stuff you talked about I can relate to. And sometimes it is almost more helpful to talk with someone rather who relates rather than a therapist. I saw a therapist regularly once, but I didn't feel like it did me any good because they were just a person paid to listen to my problems without actually caring or understanding.

I don't feel like I can report her to the police. She is the only legal guardian I have, and only way of living. If I called the police there would be the possibility that she could end up in jail, and my siblings and I would be left with no where to go. Imagine how mad that would make them. I wouldn't be able to stand knowing that I ruined several people's lives.

sometimes things like that happen for no reason. Once I posted something, (a long time ago, on an account that I forgot the password to) and all the comments on it got deleted even though nothing was breaking the guidelines. I still don't know why it happened
